## Analysis Summary

Your page has a solid foundation, but there's room to better align with your target keywords. Here's my reasoning behind the suggestions:

**Title Tag Improvements:**
Your current title uses "Genuine" instead of your target terms. I've repositioned your primary keywords—"handmade leather wallets," "premium leather bags," and "artisan leather goods"—to appear earlier and more prominently. Each option balances keyword inclusion with natural readability while staying within the optimal 50-60 character range. The brand name is shortened to preserve space for keywords.

**Meta Description Enhancements:**
Your existing description already mentions "handmade leather wallets" (excellent!), but misses "premium leather bags" and "artisan leather goods." My suggestions weave in all three target phrases naturally while maintaining your strong selling points: ethical sourcing and free shipping. Each includes a clear call-to-action ("Shop now," "Order today," "Explore") to improve click-through rates, and all stay within the 150-160 character sweet spot.

**H1 Optimization:**
Your current H1 focuses on price, which is conversion-focused but doesn't leverage keyword opportunities. The suggested versions incorporate multiple target keywords while remaining human-friendly and descriptive. They broaden the scope from just wallets to include your full product range, matching searcher intent for both wallet and bag queries.

**Additional Observations:**
Your Open Graph tags (og:title and og:description) also miss the target keywords "premium leather bags" and "artisan leather goods." These control how your page appears when shared on social media, so optimizing them could extend your reach beyond search.

Would you like me to refine any of these, try different keywords, or analyse additional tags (e.g. og:title, canonical URL)?
